author: The Infographics Show
description:
What happens if one day everyone decided to withdrawal their money from that bank at the same time? Banks are supposed to have your money secured, but what is actually inside the bank vault will shock you.

 In today's new video we break down the terrifying anatomy of a financial collapse, from the "Twitter runs" of 2023 that moved $42 billion in a single day to the emergency "bank holidays" used to stop a total system meltdown. Find out what happens when you try to take your money out of the bank, only to find out the bank doesn't have your money, and it never did. 

CHAPTERS:
0:00 - The Illusion of the Vault
0:41 - What Breaks the Trust?
1:38 - The Digital Stampede
2:11 - Feedback Loops: Fear Feeds Fear
3:07 - The History of Panic: 1930 vs. 2023
3:58 - Buying Time with "Friction"
4:54 - Lender of Last Resort
5:34 - The FDIC & Deposit Insurance
6:26 - The Point of No Liquidity
7:30 - The Nuclear Option: Bank Holidays
8:43 - Post-Collapse: Do You Get Your Money Back?
9:32 - The $250,0
title: What If Everyone Emptied Their Bank Account Today
